newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soybeans rise sharply on strong exports.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soybeans rise sharply on strong exports.

text.p: CBOT soybean futures rose sharply on news of stronger-than-expected weekly U.S. export inspections, floor sources said.
Cargill was featured buying 3.0 million bushels, some traders noted.
"They are huge and that is what got everybody going," a floor trader said of just-released export inspection data for soybeans.
The U.S. Department of Agriculture reported earlier Monday that weekly soybean inspections totalled 38.9 million bushels. Trade forecasts had ranged from 25.0 to 30.0 million.
At 1039 CST November soybeans stood 6-1/2 cents a bushel higher at $7.05-1/2 after briefing peaking at $7.08.
